ArchitectureNotes.objective: Спроектировать модульную Android-архитектуру (Clean Architecture: data / domain / presentation) для альтернативного клиента Yi-камер. Каждый модуль должен иметь чёткий contract, measurable verification, и observable log markers.
ArchitectureNotes.non-goal: Не создавать server-side компонент; не делать iOS/桌面 версию; не поддерживать камеры не-Yi.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-1: Yi Cloud API может измениться без предупреждения — весь API-интерфейс инкапсулирован в M-HTTP с version-fallback layer.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-2: Video arrives over the vendor P2P libraries; I-frames are AES-encrypted with a key derived from the camera password (no cloud handshake). Native bring-up (M-P2P-NATIVE) is the riskiest module.
ArchitectureNotes.risk-3: Local RTSP discovery не работает из-за firewall NAT — требуется fallback к cloud relay.

notes.note-1: Tokens stored in EncryptedSharedPreferences backed by Android Keystore.
notes.note-2: Token refresh happens automatically before API calls via Retrofit interceptor.
notes.note-3: Reverse-engineered auth endpoint: GET /v4/users/login (query params: seq, account, password, dev_name, dev_type, dev_os_version). Refresh: POST /v4/users/auth_token. Response code is a String; missing access_token -> InvalidCredentials.
notes.note-4: Plan 01-08 (CAM-02): explicit login hops on code 20253 and then discovers the region by device list (DeviceListCheckPort: GET /v5/devices/list, code + count). Bound per login call: 3 logins + 3 list checks, no retries; never on refresh or app start; a manual server disables both.
notes.note-5: Region rule as built (addendum): keep the first region whose /v5/devices/list answers code 20000 with count > 0; if none, keep the first region where login succeeded. A wrong password stops the loop; a network error keeps the last good session. loginMutex serialises presses; token refresh is suppressed while the check runs. This login discovery is the only place the region is chosen: the camera registry has no region fallback (tokens are per region).
notes.note-6: SEC-04 (plan 01-09 review fix): logout() is fail-closed. It clears the session, then calls LogoutCleanup synchronously; log [Auth][logout][BLOCK_LOGOUT_CLEANUP] cleared=true, or code=LOGOUT_CLEANUP_FAILED type=NAME.

notes.note-1: Signed GET (hmac via M-HTTP YiRequestSigner). BRANCH A (01-PROBE-RESULTS.md + addendum): only /v5/devices/list; shared cameras are rows of the same list; the deviceshare shareddetail path is a PUT and is never called. Region = the one kept by login discovery (M-AUTH); the registry never switches region (tokens are per region). Per refresh: 1 list GET + at most 1 /v4/tnp/device_info per TNP camera without a stored license for the same DID.
notes.note-2: Live stream URL format depends on camera model — need per-model resolver.
notes.note-3: Source order as built (DeviceSourcePlan, BRANCH A): OWNED_PATHS = [/v5/devices/list]; no shared path (shared cameras are rows of the same list, category/share), no /v4 fallback (DevicePaths.LIST_V4 is a named constant only). Code 20200 or empty data = no cameras: Room and the P2P store are cleared. Outcomes: 401/20201/20202/20203 -> Unauthorized; IO, 5xx, non-JSON -> FetchFailed; any other code -> ServerRejected (CAMERA_SERVER_ERROR); errors never touch the cache or the store.
notes.note-4: No BLOCK_REGION_FALLBACK in this module (deviation from plan 01-09, per the addendum): the registry uses the region kept by M-AUTH login discovery. The logout wipe is triggered by M-AUTH (LogoutCleanup -> clearSignedOutData); purgeIfSignedOut runs from MainActivity at start without a session. Both log [Camera][clearAll][BLOCK_CLEAR_CAMERA_DATA]; there is no export named clearAll.
notes.note-5: getLiveStreamUrl stays as legacy (the cloud list carries no stream URL, so it throws NoStreamUrl after a refresh); live view goes through getCredentials in GSD Phase 2.
notes.note-6: 2026-10-16 (GSD Phase 2, plan 02-01): every camera without a transportVerified record gets at most one signed GET /v4/tnp/device_info per user refresh (not only TNP-by-type cameras); verified records are reused with zero extra calls; a network failure keeps a verified record or yields UNKNOWN / via=none (never a guess). The registry implements P2pCredentialsSource (export credentialsFor). Value-free markers: [Camera][creds][BLOCK_RESOLVE_P2P_CREDENTIALS] transport= via=deviceInfo|uid|none listType= tnpInfo=ok|incomplete|notTnp|rejected|failed|reused hasPassword= needsPincode=, and the summary stored= withLicense= withPassword= verified=.
